# AIS-EVAL-10

**Are the evals repeatable evidence, run more than once on a versioned, held-out set?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | EVAL: Evaluation as evidence |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.evals.repeats`, `elements.ai.evals.dataset_version`, `elements.ai.evals.gating` |

## Why it matters

A model that answers differently each time is judged on one draw unless each case is repeated, and an eval set used while tuning prompts measures memory, not quality.

## Rule

Every eval with gating true has repeats of at least 3 and a dataset_version.

## Sources

- NIST AI 600-1, Generative AI Profile (2024) (`nist-600-1`)
- Microsoft, Copilot Studio agent evaluation and its test methods (2026) (`cs-eval`)
